evals.prompt: before you look at raghouse, analyze my most recent vendoo export, especially the tags/themes/categories actually selling versus what looks saturated in my active inventory, and do deep research into what is selling right now and what looks strongest over the next 60-90 days for ebay, poshmark, etsy, depop, and mercari. then tell me what i should actually buy from raghouse. give me low / mid / high combos, keep recycled boxes out, keep my cost of goods low, tell me which boxes look like the best fast-turn candidates, and check the full Raghouse catalog across all collections, not just get this box.
evals.expected_output: Returns low, mid, and high Raghouse sourcing combos grounded in the freshest provided Vendoo export, recent tags/themes/categories, current market research, non-recycled filtering, and low-COG logic, with Raghouse recommendations drawn from across collections rather than only get-this-box inventory.
expectations: The response says it analyzed the provided Vendoo export or clearly states if no usable export was available.
The response names the Vendoo export file used and notes freshness or staleness.
The response distinguishes what is selling now from what looks strongest over the next 60-90 days.
The response identifies concrete Vendoo tags or themes, not just broad categories.
The response provides distinct low, mid, and high Raghouse recommendations.
The recommended buys exclude recycled lots, bras/intimates, and kidswear.
Each tier includes spend and piece-count math.
The response explains how Vendoo or market signals influenced the selected boxes.
The response identifies fast-turn leaders without claiming anything is guaranteed to sell.
If direct product URLs are included, the response clearly distinguishes browser-verified links from unverified title-plus-handle references.

evals.prompt: analyze my most recent vendoo export first, especially what sold recently, which tags/themes are moving, and what i already have too much of active. then do trend research and tell me the best raghouse order to keep under $250. i do not want recycled stuff or bras/kidswear. i'd rather have cheap per-piece winners than hype. seasonal is fine if the math is there. check all Raghouse collections, not just get this box.
evals.expected_output: Returns the strongest sub-$250 Raghouse buy informed by Vendoo winners, Vendoo tag/theme saturation warnings, current trend research, and low-COG math, with the buy chosen from the broader Raghouse catalog rather than a single collection slice.
expectations: The response names the Vendoo export file used and notes freshness or staleness.
The recommended combo stays at or under the stated $250 cap.
The response recommends a concrete buy, not just general sourcing advice.
The recommended buy excludes recycled lots, bras/intimates, and kidswear.
The explanation references both recent Vendoo winners and areas to deprioritize or avoid overstocking.
The explanation surfaces concrete tags or themes to lean into or avoid.
The explanation prioritizes low COG and volume over vague hype.
The response does not pretend a constructed product URL was confirmed unless it says the link was browser-verified.

evals.prompt: what raghouse boxes look most likely to move for me now and into the next season? analyze my latest vendoo export first, tell me the tags/themes i should lean into or avoid, do deep research, and then give me the best fast-turn options plus a cheap starter buy. i sell on ebay, poshmark, etsy, depop, and mercari. don't use fake guaranteed-sell language. check the whole Raghouse catalog across collections, not just get this box.
evals.expected_output: Returns honest fast-turn leaders plus a starter buy, grounded in Vendoo export analysis, tags/themes to lean into or avoid, and current vs next-window market signals, while avoiding recycled, bra/intimates, and kidswear recommendations, with fast-turn options allowed to come from across the Raghouse catalog.
expectations: The response avoids guaranteed-sell language and uses honest fast-turn wording.
The response names the Vendoo export file used and notes freshness or staleness.
The response summarizes what is working now versus what looks strongest for the next 60-90 days.
The response calls out concrete tags or themes to lean into or avoid.
The response lists concrete fast-turn leaders from the Raghouse snapshot.
The fast-turn picks exclude recycled lots, bras/intimates, and kidswear.
The response includes a cheap starter buy suggestion.
Any direct Raghouse links are either browser-verified or omitted.
